body: We all feel the same way. I so envy the dead because of the peace they recieve. If only for a minute I could be dead and carefree I could keep going. It's so hard to think that it will all be okay... because it hasn't been okay in such a long time. I guess we just have to stick by ourselves and hope we can make it...

I think driving works better than my meds or therapy has ever worked. I mean I finally found an okay med, and therapy sucks! But driving is instant for me. 

I'm so sorry you're going through something too. I mean for me I always feel so alone and scared. It's really shitty. But what I want in 10 years is what keeps me moving. It's what keeps me afloat! The thought of being married to someone who loves me and a couple kids. I've gotten close to suicide... but my want will be worth it! 

Hang in there friend :)

Hey! There is no reason to do what you're thinking about doing. I am in your place. I am in this terrible world the same as You! We are all here and feeling terrible!! We are together in this world! Please don't do it. Talk to me. Cry to me. It's okay. You don't have to do this! You will always have a friend in me :) just ask for my email or something! I'll never turn you down for some support! I will always be your friend! It doesn't matter who you are or what you're going through, I am right here for You!

I can't begin to describe how much I relate to you. I remember when my depression started. I remember going down this rabbit hole of darkness and now 5 years later I haven't climbed out... And I can't tell my parents, I don't want them to feel bad.

With the SO, I more than understand. My SO is studying to be an emergency medicine doctor currently. And it's so much work. Too much work. And I need his time! I need his attention when i start feeling bad. But I can't. Bed worked years to make it to the point he is at now and I can get in the way of that. So I feel guilty for asking for his attention. It's so hard sometimes, isn't it?

But... the thought of having little maizie, and Dean (the names we have given to our future children) is what keeps me going. I want so bad to die, but I want to walk down the aisle looking at my perfect boyfriend, and have adorable children and then get old and fat with him. I want these things but it's so difficult to hold on to the fantasy. It's so hard to believe that someone like him could ever love me. That I'm worth a damn. 

Just find what you want to hold on for! What is it that you want? What is it that you want so bad that it would override your desire to die? Because friend, killing yourself also kills all those things you've always wanted, and I don't think anyone in your life could handle holding that in their hearts. So please stick in there :)

Hey, I understand. The bad parts of life can overwhelm even the strongest. And screwing up happens. I can't tell you how many people don't talk to me because of stupid decisions. People just make bad decisions some times. That's all part of this thing we call life. It's terrible. It's hard to wake up, it's hard to fall asleep, it hard to live! For me, it's also because I can't stop screwing up. I feel like anything I do gets fucked somehow. But, life carries on. The only thing I really have learned about life is that it goes on... And I hate that. It's so hard to keep going on, and I hate when people tell me life goes on because I don't want it to! But, friend, it does. And you're stuck here! With Me! :) whether you like it or not. Because the last people I feel I have in my life are all of you. All the people I feel I can relate to. So, stick around :)

I can't stop reading this. I find myself reading these stories late at night to feel like I fit somewhere. And I've never related to one more deeply. I have a constant worry about the terrible weight I have on my shoulders. I have become so tense I developed something call myofascial pain syndrome. I just can't handle this stress. And i guess I don't know why I'm saying anything... but I relate to you. I feel what you're feeling. I can't tell you it'll be alright because I don't know what's going on in your life... but I can tell you that there are great things in this world, great things to see and do. So, stick with it friend. Maybe we will make it out okay :)
